$schema: families: one entry per family of mods that does one job. `mods` and `addons` are keyed by `<minecraft>/<loader>` and hold mods.txt lines (full mods.txt syntax). See docs/catalog.md.

tags.storage: digital or bulk storage, pipes, logistics
tags.quests: a quest book that leads the player
tags.qol: recipes viewer, tooltips, backpacks, small conveniences
tags.tune: lets the pack author change recipes and add items

families.title: Thermal Series
families.summary: ores and alloys, machines and dynamos, ducts, farming machines, Fluxbore and jetpack
families.when: first hour of a tech pack; gentle curve, every machine is one block

families.title: Create
families.summary: rotational power, contraptions, trains; builds that move
families.when: when the player wants to build machines by hand rather than place blocks; heavier on the client

families.title: Mekanism
families.summary: ore tripling, chemistry, Digital Miner, MekaSuit
families.when: mid game, after a first machine line; the endgame armor of most tech packs

families.title: Applied Energistics 2
families.summary: digital storage, terminals, autocrafting
families.when: once chests overflow, usually chapter 3-4 of a tech pack

families.title: Extreme Reactors
families.summary: BigReactors: multiblock reactors and turbines on yellorium
families.when: when energy becomes the bottleneck

families.title: QuarryPlus
families.summary: the BuildCraft quarry: markers, Quarry Plus, Chunk Destroyer; removes the mining grind
families.when: as soon as a dynamo makes 40 RF/t

families.title: RFTools
families.summary: the Builder with shape cards: digs, moves, copies structures
families.when: late game, a quarry alternative

families.title: Logistics
families.summary: one pipe for everything, drawers, bigger chests, wireless energy
families.when: from the first chest

1.20.1/forge: manual:flux-networks   # CurseForge only: Prism -> Mods -> Download mods -> CurseForge

families.title: DivineRPG
families.summary: eight dimensions, bosses, gear tiers; a whole second line of progression
families.when: a parallel line next to tech; boss drops are grindy by default, tune the drop rates
families.tune_hint: 4 boss fragments = 1 soul instead of 8 (pack config)

families.title: The Twilight Forest
families.summary: one dimension with a chain of bosses and dungeons
families.when: a lighter RPG line than DivineRPG; good for a mixed pack

1.20.1/forge: manual:the-twilight-forest   # CurseForge only: Prism -> Mods -> Download mods -> CurseForge

families.title: Botania
families.summary: mana from flowers, no energy numbers; magic built from vanilla-looking blocks
families.when: a magic line that does not need a tech line

families.title: Ars Nouveau
families.summary: spells you compose from glyphs, familiars, rituals
families.when: the friendliest spell mod; works in coop

families.title: Forestry and bees
families.summary: multiblock farms, classic bee breeding, resource bees that feed the tech line
families.when: chapter 5 of a tech pack; bees that make Thermal, Mekanism and AE2 materials

families.title: Farmer's Delight
families.summary: cutting board, cooking pot, skillet, stove, four crops, meals with Nourishment
families.when: whenever you are hungry; one food mod is enough, more only adds near-identical dishes

families.title: World generation
families.summary: more biomes, deeper terrain, better vanilla structures; data only, no render cost
families.when: new chunks only, so decide before the world is made

1.20.1/forge: biomes-o-plenty   # coexists with Terralith through TerraBlender
lithostitched   # Tectonic library, Modrinth does not mark it required

families.title: FTB coop and quests
families.summary: quest book, shared team progress, claimed chunks that keep running, voice chat, free waystones, no item loss on death
families.when: any pack for 2-6 friends

families.title: Quality of life
families.summary: recipe viewer, ore and drop tables, block info on screen, in-game manuals, backpacks, food tooltips, drag over slots, a trash block
families.when: always

families.title: Performance
families.summary: render and memory fixes with no gameplay change; Embeddium + Oculus instead of OptiFine (OptiFine breaks Forge mods and is not on Modrinth)
families.when: always; required on Apple Silicon and on 8 GB machines

families.title: Textures and shaders
families.summary: a 32x texture pack and a shader pack, shipped enabled
families.when: mid and high tier machines; skip on 8 GB or integrated graphics

families.title: KubeJS tuning layer
families.summary: scripts that change recipes and add items; packloom writes them from tune.json
families.when: when the pack changes any recipe, difficulty preset or adds a cross-mod item
